title: Coniugātiō Praesentis Mediī-Passīvī
subtitle: Tempus praesēns modī indicātīvī, vōce mediā-passīvā, verbōrum in -ω; sēnsus vōcis mediae, nova discipulīs Latīnē doctīs.
objectives: Coniugāre plēnē tempus praesēns indicātīvī mediī-passīvī verbī λύω per omnēs persōnās, utrōque numerō
Explicāre cūr fōrmae mediae et passīvae sint IDENTICAE in tempore praesentī (distinctiō sōlum in aoristō/futūrō, gradibus posteriōribus)
Distinguere sēnsum vōcis mediae (subiectum agit in/prō sē ipsō) ā sēnsū vōcis passīvae (subiectum patitur āctiōnem ab aliō)

content.intro: Ἀγάθων καὶ Μελίτη ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ εἰσίν. Λουόμεθα, λέγει Μελίτη. Notāvistī: λουόμεθα — nōn “lavāmus [aliud]”, sed “lavāmur nōs ipsōs”. Hodiē discis vōcem mediam: elementum omnīnō novum discipulīs Latīnē doctīs.
content.explanation:
Ἀγάθων καὶ Μελίτη ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ εἰσίν. “Λουόμεθα,” λέγει Μελίτη, “ὅτι καλόν ἐστι τὸ ὕδωρ.” Ὁ δοῦλος λύεται ὑπὸ τοῦ δεσπότου. Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Καὶ ἐγὼ βούλομαι λύεσθαι.” (Agathōn et Melitē in flūmine sunt. “Nōs lavāmus,” dīcit Melitē, “quia aqua pulchra est.” Servus ā dominō līberātur. Agathōn dīcit: “Et ego volō līberārī.”)

Notāvistīne λουόμεθα (nōs ipsōs lavāmus, medium) versus λύεται (solvitur, passīvum) — eadem cōnstrūctiō morphologica, sēnsus dīversus? Graecum habet trēs vōcēs verbī — āctīva (iam nōta), media, et passīva — ubi Latīnum habet sōlum duās (āctīva, passīva, cum “verbīs dēpōnentibus” tractantibus fōrmam passīvam cum sēnsū āctīvō, cāsus speciālis). Vōx media indicat subiectum agere in sē ipsum, prō sē ipsō, vel cum īnstrūmentō/effectū speciālī ad sē pertinente — nōn sōlum “agō” (āctīva) neque “patior” (passīva), sed aliquid intermedium. Bona nova prō incipientibus: in tempore praesentī (et imperfectō, quem posteā vidēbis), fōrmae mediae et passīvae sunt morphologicē identicae — ūnum sōlum paradigma servit ambōbus sēnsibus; contextus sōlus dēterminat utrum medium an passīvum intellegendum sit.

rules.heading: a) Praesēns Indicātīvum Mediī-Passīvī: λύομαι
rules.body:
PersōnaSingulārisPlūrālis
1ªλύομαιλυόμεθα
2ªλύῃλύεσθε
3ªλύεταιλύονται

Nōtā λύῃ (2ª sg.): fōrma “plēna” historica erat *λύεσαι, sed σ intervōcālicum periit et ε+αι contractī sunt in η (cum iōtā subscrīptō) — exemplum contractiōnis phōnologicae, phaenomenon quod plēnius vidēbis cum verba contracta tractantur (Gradū III).

rules.heading: b) Sēnsus Vōcis Mediae
rules.body: Vōx media indicat variōs modōs quibus subiectum est speciāliter implicātum in āctiōne suā: (1) reflexīvum: λούομαι “mē lavō” (comparā λούω “lavō [aliud]”); (2) prō sē ipsō/ commodō suō: λύομαι τὸν δοῦλον potest significāre “redimō servum PRŌ MĒ IPSŌ” (nōn sōlum “solvō”); (3) reciprocum: subiecta plūrālia agunt inter sē; (4) intrānsitīvum idiōmaticum: quaedam verba habent sēnsum mediī omnīnō distīnctum ā fōrmā āctīvā, memoriae mandandum sīgillātim (ut in dictiōnāriīs annotātur).

rules.heading: c) Sēnsus Vōcis Passīvae et Īnfīnītīvus
rules.body: Sēnsus passīvus (subiectum patitur āctiōnem ab agente externō) trānsfertur exāctē sīcut Latīnē: ὁ δοῦλος λύεται potest significāre “servus solvitur/līberātur” (ab aliquō, passīvē) AUT “servus solvit/līberat SĒ” (mediē) — contextus sōlus dēcernit. Agēns passīvus (“ab aliquō”), sī explicitus, adhibet praepositiōnem ὑπό + genetīvum, quam posteā plēnius vidēbis. Īnfīnītīvus praesēns medius-passīvus fīnītur -εσθαι: λύεσθαι.

examples: λύομαι τὸν δοῦλον. — Redimō servum prō mē ipsō. (medium, commodum suī)
ὁ δοῦλος λύεται ὑπὸ τοῦ δεσπότου. — Servus līberātur ā dominō. (passīvum, agēns explicitus per ὑπό + gen.)
λουόμεθα ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ. — Lavāmus nōs in flūmine. (medium reflexīvum, 1ª pl.)
βούλεται λύεσθαι. — Vult sē solvī/līberārī. (īnfīnītīvus medius-passīvus)
οἱ πολῖται λύονται ὑπὸ τῶν νόμων; — Num cīvēs solvuntur ā lēgibus? (passīvum, interrogātiō)
τί λύῃ; — Quid tibi solvis/redimis? (2ª sg. medium)

commonMistakes.wrong: Quaerere fōrmam distīnctam prō mediō vs. passīvō in tempore praesentī, crēdēns errōrem esse sī identicae videntur.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī media et passīva SUNT morphologicē identica in praesentī (et imperfectō); distinctiō fōrmālis appāret sōlum in aoristō/futūrō.
commonMistakes.why: Discipulus incipiēns saepe crēdit omnem discrīmen sēnsūs dēbēre habēre fōrmam propriam — nōn semper vērum in Graecō.

commonMistakes.wrong: Trānsferre omnem fōrmam mediam sīcut reflexīvam Latīnam (“sē” + verbum), sine cōnsīderāre alium sēnsūs mediī.
commonMistakes.right: Cōnsīderāre contextum: medium potest significāre reflexīvum, commodum suī, reciprocum, vel sēnsum idiōmaticum proprium verbī.
commonMistakes.why: Vōx media Graeca est semantica magis dīversa quam sōlum reflexīvum Latīnum, quod discipulus Latīnē doctus tendit suppōnere.

commonMistakes.wrong: Scrībere λύεσαι prō λύῃ (2ª persōnā singulārī), suppōnendō fōrmam nōn-contractam esse rēctam in ūsū classicō.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī λύεσαι est fōrma antīquior/historica; ūsus classicus Atticus requīrit fōrmam contractam λύῃ.
commonMistakes.why: Confūsiō hīc oritur ex vīsū fōrmae historicae in explicātiōnibus grammaticīs, quae nōn est ipsa fōrma classica ūsitāta.

exercises.title: Ἐν τῷ Ποταμῷ
exercises.instructions: Lege, deinde responde secundum sensum, non verbum singulum.

exercises.title: Quid Vērē Dīcitur? (Ex Sēnsū)
exercises.instructions: Relege sententiās suprā. Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit, ex sēnsū, nōn ex nōmine vōcis.

items.statement: “Λουόμεθα” — Ἀγάθων et Μελίτη sē ipsōs lavant.
items.explanation: Λουόμεθα (medium, 1ª pl.) significat “nōs ipsōs lavāmus” — āctiō in sē ipsōs.

items.statement: “Ὁ δοῦλος λύεται ὑπὸ τοῦ δεσπότου” — servus sē ipse līberat.
items.explanation: Falsum: ὑπὸ τοῦ δεσπότου (“ā dominō”) indicat agentem externum — passīvum, nōn medium reflexīvum.
Falsum: “βούλομαι λύεσθαι” significat “volō līberārī” — vult, nōn nōn vult.

items.statement: “Καλόν ἐστι τὸ ὕδωρ” explicat cūr Ἀγάθων et Μελίτη in flūmine sunt.
items.explanation: Melitē dat ratiōnem (ὅτι, “quia”) cūr sē lavent: aqua est pulchra/agreeābilis.

exercises.title: Coniugā λύομαι
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā mediī-passīvī verbī λύω.

items.prompt: Ἐγὼ ___ ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ. (1ª sg., “lavor/mē lavō”)
items.explanation: Prīma persōna singulāris mediī-passīvī: λύομαι.
Secunda persōna singulāris (fōrma contracta): λύῃ.

items.prompt: Ὁ δοῦλος ___ ὑπὸ τοῦ δεσπότου. (3ª sg., passīvum)
items.explanation: Tertia persōna singulāris: λύεται.
Prīma persōna plūrālis: λυόμεθα.

items.prompt: Οἱ δοῦλοι ___ ὑπὸ τῶν πολιτῶν. (3ª pl.)
items.explanation: Tertia persōna plūrālis: λύονται.

items.prompt: Quōmodo distinguuntur fōrmae mediae ā fōrmīs passīvīs in tempore praesentī?
options: per dēsinentiam propriam prō quāque vōce
nōn distinguuntur morphologicē; sōlum contextus dēcernit
items.explanation: In praesentī/imperfectō, fōrmae mediae et passīvae sunt identicae; contextus sōlus dēterminat sēnsum.
Λούομαι, medium, significat “mē lavō” — subiectum agit in sē ipsum.

items.prompt: Quae praepositiō + cāsus indicat agentem passīvum explicitum (“ab aliquō”)?
items.explanation: Ὑπό + genetīvus est cōnstrūctiō standard prō agente passīvō.

items.prompt: Quae est fōrma īnfīnītīvī praesentis mediī-passīvī verbī λύω?
items.explanation: Īnfīnītīvus medius-passīvus fīnītur -εσθαι.

items.prompt: Unde orītur fōrma contracta λύῃ (2ª sg.)?
options: ā fōrmā historicā *λύεσαι, per contractiōnem post āmissiōnem σ
est fōrma prīmāria sine ūllā contractiōne
ā verbō εἰμί, nōn ā λύω
items.explanation: Σ intervōcālicum periit, deinde ε+αι contractī sunt in η (cum iōtā subscrīptō).

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Fōrmae mediae et passīvae sunt morphologicē identicae in tempore praesentī.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: distīnctiō fōrmālis appāret sōlum in aoristō/futūrō.

items.statement: Vōx media Graeca significat sōlum “sē” reflexīvum, sīcut in linguīs Rōmānicīs.
items.explanation: Falsum: media potest significāre reflexīvum, commodum suī, reciprocum, vel sēnsum idiōmaticum proprium.

items.statement: Λατīnum classicum habet vōcem mediam plēnē distīnctam ā vōce āctīvā et passīvā.
items.explanation: Falsum: Latīnum habet sōlum āctīvam et passīvam (cum verbīs dēpōnentibus ut cāsus speciālis); media Graeca est genuīnē nova.

items.statement: Prīma persōna plūrālis mediī-passīvī verbī λύω est λυόμεθα.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: -όμεθα est dēsinentia prīmae persōnae plūrālis mediī-passīvī.

summary: Praesēns mediī-passīvī λύομαι: λύομαι, λύῃ, λύεται // λυόμεθα, λύεσθε, λύονται.
Media et passīva sunt IDENTICA morphologicē in praesentī/imperfectō; distinctiō appāret sōlum in aoristō/futūrō.
Vōx media significat: reflexīvum, commodum suī, reciprocum, vel sēnsum idiōmaticum proprium verbī — magis dīversa quam Latīnum offert.
Agēns passīvus explicitus: ὑπό + genetīvus (“ab aliquō”).
